verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a dashboard import tool for bringing an existing internet-accessible MySQL or MariaDB database over with no downtime. It also documents attaching an existing MySQL database as an external keyspace so it can be queried through Vitess before importing. A community user corroborates a smooth production migration to PlanetScale Postgres Metal, though another notes the Heroku path was harder because Heroku blocks logical replication. Missing for 10: a documented Postgres-specific import path in the evidence, coverage of sources that are not internet-accessible, and an easier path for sources like Heroku that block logical replication.
